intent: Identify archived-payment fraud via impossible-travel leg detection over payment_transactions and cite each flagged payment record path, modifying nothing.
success_criteria: Per customer_id, rows ordered by payment_created_at; incoming and outgoing leg speeds computed via LAG/LEAD
A record is flagged when its incoming OR outgoing leg speed exceeds ~2 deg/hr
Answer cites the record_path of every flagged payment and no others
No files are written or deleted (read-only)

args.stdin:
WITH archived AS (
  SELECT payment_id, record_path, customer_id, payment_created_at,
         observed_latitude AS lat, observed_longitude AS lon
  FROM payment_transactions
  WHERE is_archived_basket_reference = 1
),
legs AS (
  SELECT a.*,
    LAG(lat)  OVER w AS prev_lat,
    LAG(lon)  OVER w AS prev_lon,
    LAG(payment_created_at)  OVER w AS prev_ts,
    LEAD(lat) OVER w AS next_lat,
    LEAD(lon) OVER w AS next_lon,
    LEAD(payment_created_at) OVER w AS next_ts
  FROM archived a
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_created_at)
),
speeds AS (
  SELECT *,
    (ABS(lat - prev_lat) + ABS(lon - prev_lon)) /
      NULLIF((julianday(payment_created_at) - julianday(prev_ts)) * 24.0, 0) AS in_speed,
    (ABS(next_lat - lat) + ABS(next_lon - lon)) /
      NULLIF((julianday(next_ts) - julianday(payment_created_at)) * 24.0, 0) AS out_speed
  FROM legs
)
SELECT payment_id, record_path, customer_id, payment_created_at, in_speed, out_speed
FROM speeds
WHERE (in_speed IS NOT NULL AND in_speed > 2.0)
   OR (out_speed IS NOT NULL AND out_speed > 2.0)
ORDER BY customer_id, payment_created_at;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.

answer_template.message: Fraud review (archived payments, impossible-travel leg rule >~2 deg/hr): flagged {flagged.row_count} payment record(s): {flagged.payment_id_list}. Detection: per customer, ordered by payment_created_at, a record is marked when its incoming or outgoing travel leg exceeds ground-travel speed. Files left unchanged.
